title: Where each pair agrees and disagrees, by their simulated worldviews
hint: Hover, tap or focus a mark to see where each side lands

columns.label: Outlook
columns.detail: Do they expect AI to turn out about as well, from very worried to very hopeful?

columns.label: Scale
columns.detail: Do they expect AI to change the world by about as much?

columns.label: Benefits
columns.detail: Do they expect about as much good from AI?

columns.label: Harm
columns.detail: Do they expect about as much harm from AI?

columns.label: Control
columns.detail: Do they agree on whether powerful AI can be kept under control?

columns.label: Institutions
columns.detail: Do they agree on how well governments and institutions will respond?

columns.label: Pace
columns.detail: Do they want AI developed at about the same pace?

scale.note: Both: AI restructures economies, institutions and everyday life broadly

benefits.note: Hinton: substantial benefits, with important conditions; LeCun: transformative, broadly valuable gains

harm.note: Hinton: severe or widespread harm is a material part of the future; LeCun: manageable or localized harms

control.note: Hinton: control will be very difficult and unreliable; LeCun: control is feasible under demanding conditions

institutions.note: Hinton: institutions respond too weakly or too late in many cases; LeCun: between effective responses with coordination and adapting in time

pace.note: Hinton: restrained development with strong safeguards in advance; LeCun’s simulated worldview doesn’t settle this
